cards.backText: Inani lenye indlela engcono kakhulu oyidelayo lapho ukhetha indlela eyodwa esikhundleni senye.
Ukuhamba kwamanzi ngolwelwesi esuka endaweni enesilinganiso esincane sezinto ezincibilikile eya endaweni enesilinganiso esikhulu.
Isilinganiso sokuthi amanani asakazeke kangakanani ezungeze isilinganiso esimaphakathi.
Into esheshisa ukusabela kwamakhemikhali ngaphandle kokusetshenziswa iphele kulokho kusabela.
Indlela yokucabanga ephindaphindekayo engaphambukisa ukwahlulela nokuthatha izinqumo.
Isivinini sento kanye nesiqondiso sokuhamba kwayo.
Indlela lapho umsebenzi uxazulula inkinga ngokuzibiza ukuze uxazulule izingxenye ezincane zaleyo nkinga.
